svg.text: ATSAI TECHNOLOGIES · OFFICIAL BRAND IDENTITY & DESIGN SYSTEM
Intelligent Talent Acquisition. Engineered for Scale.
The new official high-definition vector logo and application emblem for ATSAI Technologies.

g.text: Master lockup for light headers, white documents, and corporate stationery.
Luminous sapphire & electric cyan radiance for dark interfaces and dashboard chrome.
Constructed from geometric precision planes: The dual-pillar 'A' frame represents ATSAI architecture;
the interior ascending chevron symbolizes career progression & hiring success; the luminous spark node marks AI convergence.
